title: Unreal Editor Icons

snippets.label: FSlateIcon
snippets.note: FSlateIcon is for menus, toolbars and commands (the Icon argument of FToolMenuEntry::InitToolBarButton / InitMenuEntry). Brush is for widgets, e.g. SNew(SImage).Image(...).

snippets.label: FSlateIcon
snippets.note: FSlateIcon is for menus, toolbars and commands (FToolBarBuilder::AddToolBarButton, FMenuBuilder::AddMenuEntry). Brush is for widgets, e.g. SNew(SImage).Image(...).

snippets.label: FSlateIcon
snippets.note: This name belongs to the style set "{style}" of one editor module or plugin; it only works while that module is loaded. FindSlateStyle returns nullptr otherwise.

snippets.label: Brush
snippets.note: The engine itself does not register this icon under a name (it may even be unused), so it is loaded from the engine folder. Editor tools only: Engine/Content/Editor is not part of packaged games. Keep the brush alive, e.g. as a member variable or inside your FSlateStyleSet.

tint.label: C++
tint.code: SNew(SImage).ColorAndOpacity(FLinearColor::FromSRGBColor(FColor::FromHex(TEXT("{hex}"))))  // multiplies the icon colour; or SetColorAndOpacity() on an existing SImage
